name: audit-forwarded-exports
goal: Audit explicit named runtime forwarding exports without admitting type-only, wildcard or misleading exports

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: Owner-local implementations retain explicit named forwarding exports for compatibility, but hasNamedValueExport only recognizes declaration forms. Audit falsely rejects these public names. Type-only or wildcard exports must still not satisfy a required runtime export.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: Standard adapter and generated-project naming tests exercised declarations, but not runtime export lists. Extend their existing matrices with direct, alias, multiline and local export lists plus type-only, wildcard, comment and string negative cases.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Test-only 37701c64 fails the explicit runtime forward-export naming assertions and the generated-project audit case. Immutable red c97ea5aba4b3cf342e6eb2ddca6979747c6e23081f33cd134b940ca5c16948cb preserves both standardized suites.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Recognize explicit non-type export lists and their exported aliases in structural source. Preserve declaration checks, and reject type-only names, wildcard lists, wrong aliases, comments and strings. Keep architecture and naming limits unchanged.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: Required runtime export names now recognize explicit alias and local export lists through structural source. Type-only and wildcard forms remain insufficient; existing declaration names and architecture rules are unchanged. The standard adapter matrix and generated-project audit cover both acceptance and rejection.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.

Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
